title: Russia's 268-Drone + Iskander-M Overnight Attack Kills 4 — Chornomorsk, Dnipro, Kherson Hit
detail: During the overnight hours of May 2-3, 2026, Russia launched one of its largest combined aerial attacks: 268 strike drones (Shahed-type including jet-powered variants, Gerbera, and Italmas models) plus 1 Iskander-M ballistic missile. Ukrainian air defenses shot down or suppressed 249 of the 268 drones. The attack killed at least 4 civilians and caused significant damage across three regions. In Chornomorsk (Odesa region): a strike on the city's suburbs destroyed 35 residential buildings, killing 2 people and injuring 5. In Dnipro: 1 civilian was killed and the roof of a five-story apartment block was destroyed, with wooden beams exposed and debris scattered. In Kherson region: 1 person was killed in a separate Russian drone strike on civilian transport in the Dniprovskyi district, with a man hospitalized and an ambulance also damaged. The drones were launched from multiple directions: Kursk, Shatalovo, Oryol, Primorsko-Akhtarsk in Russia, and occupied Crimea (Hvardiiske and Chauda). The Iskander-M ballistic missile was directed at military infrastructure. Russia also struck Ternopil (Ars-Keramika warehouse and Orion Radio Plant) and port infrastructure in the Odesa region in separate attacks around this period.

media.caption: Russia's 268-drone and Iskander-M attack kills 4 civilians in Chornomorsk, Dnipro, and Kherson overnight May 2-3, 2026

title: Ukraine Fires 334 Drones at Russia — Hits Cruise Missile Carrier and Three Shadow Fleet Tankers Near Novorossiysk
detail: In a coordinated large-scale counterstrike, Ukraine's drone forces launched approximately 334 drones targeting Russian territory overnight May 3, 2026 — one of the largest Ukrainian drone barrages of the war. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian cruise missile carrier (a warship capable of firing Kalibr missiles at Ukrainian cities) and three oil tankers from Russia's 'shadow fleet' operating near the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk, Krasnodar region. The shadow fleet tankers had been used to circumvent Western oil price caps and G7 insurance restrictions to fund Russia's war machine. Russia's air defenses claimed interception of 117 Ukrainian drones during the night. Ukraine's drone forces also destroyed a Pantsir-S1 air defense system in occupied Donetsk Oblast and a Tor anti-aircraft system, plus two surveillance radars (including a P-18 in occupied Zaporizhzhia Oblast) during the first 48 hours of May — removing Russian air defense nodes and enabling deeper strikes. Al Jazeera also reported Ukrainian drones struck a Russian Baltic port in a separate operation, demonstrating Ukraine's extended 1,750 km operational reach. Ukraine launched a further strike on Russia's oil infrastructure, hitting the Tuapse refinery for the fourth consecutive time in two weeks around the same period.

media.caption: Ukraine destroys Russian Pantsir and Tor air defense systems and radars in May 2026 drone campaign while launching 334 drones at Russia
